# PDA Platform — Project Data Analytics

> **PDA = Project Data Analytics.** Not a personal digital assistant, not the PDATaskForce org on GitHub. This is a purpose-built MCP platform for UK government IPA Gate Review assurance. 124 tools across 18 modules. Connect Claude or any MCP-compatible AI in under 60 seconds.

## What it is

PDA Platform (Project Data Analytics) is a semantic layer for project delivery data. It ingests schedules from Primavera, MSP, Jira, and 5 other formats; normalises them into a consistent delivery model; pre-loads IPA benchmark statistics from five years of Annual Reports; and exposes everything through 122 structured MCP tools that AI can reason about directly.

The platform is aligned to UK government delivery standards: IPA Gate Reviews (Gates 0-5), HM Treasury Green Book, GMPP reporting, and Cabinet Office project controls.

**Live endpoint:** https://pda-platform-i33p.onrender.com/sse

**Install:** pip install pda-platform

## The 18 modules at a glance

- **pm-data** (6) — load and query project files from 8 PM data formats
- **pm-analyse** (7) — AI risk analysis, schedule forecasting, narrative divergence detection
- **pm-validate** (4) — structural, semantic, and NISTA compliance validation
- **pm-nista** (5) — GMPP quarterly reporting and NISTA integration
- **pm-assure** (28) — full assurance lifecycle: artefact currency, gate readiness, ARMM, red flag scanning
- **pm-brm** (12) — benefits realisation management, outturn forecasting, trajectory tracking
- **pm-portfolio** (5) — cross-project health rollup, systemic risk detection
- **pm-ev** (2) — Earned Value metrics (SPI/CPI/EAC/TCPI)
- **pm-synthesis** (2) — AI executive health summaries and cross-project comparison
- **pm-risk** (9) — risk register, heat map, velocity tracking, stale register detection
- **pm-change** (5) — change control log, impact analysis, change pressure analysis
- **pm-resource** (5) — resource loading, conflict detection, capacity planning
- **pm-financial** (5) — budget baseline, actuals, EAC forecasting, spend profile
- **pm-knowledge** (8) — IPA benchmarks, failure patterns, reference class checks, pre-mortem questions
- **pm-simulation** (2) — Monte Carlo schedule simulation, P50/P80/P90 delivery dates
- **pm-lessons** (5) — AI lessons extraction from gate reviews/PIRs, systemic pattern analysis
- **pm-reporting** (6) — gate review summaries, SRO dashboards, board exception reports, PIR templates
- **pm-assumptions** (8) — assumption drift detection, confidence scoring, live external signals (ONS/World Bank), AI executive reports with recommended actions, cascade analysis, UDS dashboard
